title: Updates list what’s new in a few short lines
details: release-notes.json entries are {title, details}. Installed apps get only the titles, in the signed manifest’s notes; details go to the GitHub release body. Updates leaves out notes the release you’re running already listed (Updates.news in desktop/updates.ts).

title: The Features box shows a blinking cursor while you type
details: caret::poll in native/rune-prototype/src/caret.rs now tracks the feature-request field on Settings › Features.
